text:
By Frosty Wooldridge
July 24, 2025
Remember this quote as if America’s survival depends on stopping it: “Islam is not in America to be equal to any other faith, but to become dominant. The Quran should be the highest authority in America, and Islam the only religion on Earth.” Omar Ahmad, director of Council for American Islamic Relations. He supports “Intifada” globally to exterminate all Jews from the planet. He demands that NYC dismantle its police force to be replaced by social workers. He works toward freezing rents. He wants to create state-owned grocery stores. No private property. He follows the Quran’s dictates that allow him to lie in order to gain power to install Sharia Law in New York City.
Already in Muslim-dominated Detroit, Michigan and Minneapolis, Minnesota—the majority Muslim immigrants practice Sharia Law that manifests honor killings of women, female genital mutilation, no women’s rights, rape as a man’s right, and women being 1/2 the value of a man.
Understand that when Muslims gain majority numbers, as they have in Europe, the host nations become victims of Islam’s prime directive, “Convert or kill all non-believers.”
On top of that, Mamdani is a confirmed Marxist-Communist. If you haven’t noticed, millions of people have fled Somalia, Sudan, Congo and other Muslim countries. They would flee North Korea if it weren’t for the fact that they would be executed for trying. If you flee China, they execute your family members.
Today, in New York City, a minimum of 800,000 Muslims dominate the Big Apple. Over 300,000 Muslims dominate Detroit, Michigan. Another 125,000 engulf Minneapolis, Minnesota. In fact, another Muslim immigrant from Somalia, Omar Feteh with a confirmed IQ of 68, competes for the mayorship of that once vibrant city. South Florida features 119,000 Muslims. Once they take over, Americans move out. You’ve heard of hundreds of “no-go zones” in Europe where Europeans don’t dare tread into those Muslim-dominated areas because they practice Sharia Law outside European law. Jews in Europe flee Muslim-dominated areas.
Whether it’s Palestinian Muslim Rashida Tlaib in Detroit, or Ilhan Omar in Minneapolis, or Zohran Mamdani in New York…this religion creeps closer and closer into the guts of America. Every Muslim in America, because they follow the Quran, cannot and will not support or pledge their loyalty to our U.S. Constitution. Their allegiance remains to Muhammed and Mecca where they pray to five times a day.
When in power, Islam does not allow personal freedom. It does not allow personal choice. It does not allow women to be educated. It chooses spouses for women giving them no choice. It does not allow personal religious choice.
When combined with Communism-Marxism, you’re looking at a totalitarian state that dictates your daily life. You see it in Iran. You see it in all Muslim countries. Notice that none of those Islamic countries allow any other religion to be practiced.
Notice that if you’re gay or bi-sexual or transgender in an Islamic country, and they discover your sexual choices, they kill you.
Notice at the beginning of the Hamas slaughter of Israelis, Muslims in America chanted, “Death to America.” Yet, the majority of Americans aren’t listening. Guess what? Neither did any of the European countries listen when Muslims poured into their countries. Today, there are over 10,700 mosques in Europe. Muslims have created enclaved cities where no Europeans dare to tread. Great Britain watches helplessly while over 100 Sharia Law courts carry on their Islamic Law…which is totally antithetical to England’s parliamentary laws. In a word, the United Kingdom is not ‘united’, and all of Europe will never recover from 50 million Muslims who have overwhelmed all those Western countries, their cultures and their languages. Muslims do not, cannot and will never assimilate into Western culture.
“The Islamic doctrine of ‘hijrah’ or conquest via immigration is alive and well. In a similar fashion to the movement to Medina.” It’s called ‘seeding’ another country with Muslims in order to ultimately take over that country. Right now in Sweden, once the most peaceful and successful European country, their schools have been destroyed. Their women do not dare walk down city streets without Swedish male escorts. Cars are torched in Malmo, Sweden and bombings have become commonplace. One imam has already stated, “Sweden will become Europe’s first Islamic caliphate.”
What’s beyond sickening about what’s happening in New York City stems from the fact that dingbats like AOC support Communism. She’s a U.S. House member who features the brains of a bell that can’t ring. Yet, she touts Muslim Mamdani who would support her being “honor killed” if she didn’t obey him. He supports her suffering female genital mutilation. When you start adding up how stupid AOC and her fellow Squad members are, you don’t know whether to laugh or cry. None of them have read the Quran. In the case of Ilhan Omar, or AOC, they probably cannot read or comprehend past the 6th grade level. They cannot process reality as it points to Marxism-Communism.
You must understand that every communistic or socialistic society works because the leaders lead via the barrel of a gun. In China, you possess zero personal rights. In Russia, Putin dictates everything in your life. Putin has killed hundreds of thousands in Ukraine. In North Korea, you can be executed at a moment’s notice.
As Margaret Thatcher of the UK said, “Socialism works until you run out of everybody else’s money.”
If you look at who is supporting Muslim Mamdani, it’s democrats. They support Marxim, Socialism and Communism. U.S. senators Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren support Mamdani, because they are TOO stupid to see Islam’s end-game. What they don’t understand is the fact that Mamdani works against everything that created freedom, success and wealth for the average American citizen. Mamdani would destroy the foundation of capitalism in New York City. He would turn NYC into his home country of Uganda…which he fled.
But if you look at what democrats did to America under Biden, what a “friggin’ nightmare” to our entire country. And, now, they support a Muslim-Communist to become mayor of New York City.
If elected, Mamdani will draw more Muslims to NYC by chain-migration, by erecting more mosques, by de facto installing, day by day, piece by piece…Sharia Law. He’ll turn the streets of New York City into the slums…just like Los Angeles. Worse than that, he’ll help Muslims and Islam to gain a greater footprint into America.
If Mamdani is elected, we’re going to be dealing with the fact that our country will become a country at odds with itself. As Abraham Lincoln said, “A house divided cannot stand.” Well, one look at Europe gives you an idea of what’s coming to America.
Solutions? We need to stop all Muslim immigration into America. We need to make stronger laws that outlaw “Sharia Law” and make sure it cannot be practiced in our country. We need to stomp the head of the Muslim snake and defang it before it overwhelms our country like it has in Europe.
